**CI at this exact head:** run [38400174689](https://github.com/yigini/soilfer-lims/actions/runs/38400174689), `pull_request`, attempt 1, conclusion `success`, check "Test & Build" success. The raw job log is blocked by this environment's proxy. I checked the retained original server log at `79daa45c:WP/backlog-resume-20261013/ci-38400174689-completed-success/server-tests-original.log`:
- The command was `jest --maxWorkers=1 --workerIdleMemoryLimit=512MB`.
- The summary reads `Test Suites: 362 passed, 362 total` and `Tests: 5508 passed, 5508 total`.
- It shows 362 unique `PASS tests/` suite headers, 0 `FAIL` suite headers, and both `issue_206_*` suites passing.
- `run-raw.json` binds head `1a0702b3` to conclusion success.

**My own checks at this exact head:**
- `npm ci`, then `npm run build` in `client/`: built successfully.
- `npm run lint` in `client/`: 0 errors and 14 warnings, the same baseline.
- I did not rerun the server suite locally. This sandbox's test template DB isn't seeded, and I won't write to `dev.db`. CI above is the server evidence.

**Source review against #206:**
- `SampleContainer` uses the issue's fields and kinds. It is append-only, with additive no-update and no-delete guards, an active same-sample parent rule and a mass check. Its code is checked against every sample alias in SQL.
- Container codes use the `container.codeFormat` and `container.sequenceReset` LAB registry policies and a separate additive `ContainerSequence` counter, so sample numbering is unchanged. The checksum covers the whole code, and both allocators check collisions in both directions.
- `WorkAttempt.aliquotId` is set only on a new attempt insert, whether an execution or a repeat reservation. `WorkAttempt_aliquot_insert` is additive and enforces a same-sample ACTIVE ALIQUOT. The #190 and #191 guards are byte-for-byte unchanged, and first fill refuses a different link.
- The installer has a dry run, apply and no-op path. It fingerprints old rows, does no backfill, records a receipt bound to the source hash, and refuses an unmarked populated table. The startup check is wired into `index.js` and `docker-entrypoint.sh`.
- The bulk → fine earth → aliquot acceptance test, the role and scope refusals with stable 4xx codes, and all five locales (client and server) are present.
- My interim findings are resolved. `.gitattributes` is LF again, with only the two `eol=lf` lines added. `server/app.js` equals main. The only change since 9ae02 is the accepted test-script change (#206 comment 6145765510).
- Deferred and documented in the PR: locations and custody (#207), the CONSUMED and DISPOSED transitions (#208), parent and child kinds intentionally unordered, and read-only display of the aliquot on reserved attempts.

#206 stays open until the deploy and my post-deploy check.
